items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Zutty Singleton) is the subject of the story told by the interviewer about Zully's interaction with a third party; Zutty himself does not speak about a personal relationship with Zully in this excerpt.

ctx.x: He was just going to take us out on the town. And so I didn't call him up while we were there. Because I couldn't, it was impossible for me to do it.

Now like this little English drummer, he was here, I've forgotten his name now, but he's made it big. He's done good anymore. But he would come into Ryans all the time you know, he loved Zully so. And he'd been corresponding with Zully from England before he came here. But anyway, one night Zully came home and said, what's his name, I can't think of his name. But anyway Zully said he was going to New Orleans and he said, Marge I gave him ten dollars because he looked like he's kind of beat. Now why did you give…
And do you know that boy, it wasn't but the year before last when Zutty first got the stroke, he sent a telegram and said he was having a benefit for Zutty in Frankfurt, Germany.
